description:
List videos

List video posts (Reels) for a content group. Filter by status if you only need a subset (e.g. status=scheduled).

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the preceding page. Keep the same content group and status. Offset is not supported.

limit.description: Page size 1–200, default 50. Use a plain decimal integer.

anyOf.description: Post lifecycle status. `partial` indicates at least one targeted platform succeeded and at least one failed — check `platform_errors` for the per-platform breakdown.

name: listVideos
